subject: CloudBank request: IR playbook, scoped logs, and SOC 2 mapping
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cloudbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: cloudbank-security@cloudbank.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IR artifacts and scoped logs for July 20 outage

Vanessa,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. CloudBank had a brief production degradation yesterday (Jul 20) that affected a small subset of users. Our security team has asked for a scoped evidence package so we can complete our internal post-incident review and update our SOC 2 tracker. Could you please provide:

- The current Incident Response playbook you would share under an NDA (redacted where appropriate)
- A small sample of server-side logs and request traces centered on 2026-07-20 02:10–02:40 UTC (IP/PII redacted)
- SOC 2 control mapping that shows which Redwood procedures cover detection & response (CAI Q references appreciated)

We appreciate a first delivery by EOD Wed (Jul 22) if possible. If there are any formal steps (procurement NDA/secure upload) we should follow, let me know.

Regards,
Elaine Park
Sr. Security Engineer, CloudBank

--
cloudbank-security@cloudbank.com
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cloudbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts and scoped logs for July 20 outage

Elaine — thanks for the note and the timeline. We can get a scoped package over to CloudBank by end of day Wed. Quick notes:

- I'll lead coordination and share the playbook (IRP) with high-level redactions for any internal contact addresses.
- Aditya will pull the request traces and a tight archive containing only the time window you specified; we will redact IPs and any fields flagged as PII.
- Laura will attach the SOC 2 mapping matrix and CAIQ crosswalk.

We prefer sharing artifacts via the secure Drive folder (link below) and will also provide hashes for the zip. If your security team requires an SFTP or a signed NDA prior to transfer, say the word and we'll route it through Legal.

Planned deliverables (Wed EOD):
- redwood_IR_playbook_v1.3.pdf (redacted)
- forensics_scope_log_samples_20260720.zip (sample subset, redacted)
- soc2_mapping_matrix.xlsx (controls mapping + CAIQ refs)

Let me know if you want a short walkthrough call after we upload.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none (will upload to secure Drive)
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:48:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts and scoped logs for July 20 outage

Vanessa / Laura — I pulled the initial log slice this afternoon and started redaction. Summary:

- Files prepared: request_traces_20260720_windowA.ndjson (03:05–03:40 UTC), auth_events_20260720.log (03:00–03:50 UTC).
- Redaction performed: client_ip -> <REDACTED_IP>, user_email -> <REDACTED_EMAIL>, session_id trimmed.
- Sample size: ~18 MB compressed (we'll send a tighter subset for CloudBank).

Question for Laura: do we include the kernel-level timestamps in the sample, or strip to application-level only? CloudBank requested "request traces" so I defaulted to app-level. Also tagging for chain-of-custody: I will add a small manifest.txt inside the zip with checksums and the extraction checklist.

I'll stage the package to the secure Drive folder and wait on Vanessa for authoring the manifest and playbook redaction guidance.

- Aditya
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cloudbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: cloudbank-security@cloudbank.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 00:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts and scoped logs for July 20 outage

Thanks — this looks good. A couple of clarifications from our side before you upload: 

1) For SOC 2 mapping, can you indicate which control IDs (CC6.1/CC7.2-style) map to detection and incident response steps? A one-sheet mapping is ideal.
2) For the forensics sample, please ensure any internal hostnames are generalized; CloudBank will not accept full hostnames with customer identifiers.
3) Please include the CAIQ section references that align to the playbook (e.g., CAIQ Control x.y -> IR step #).

No NDA required for this level of redacted artifacts, but we'll need the secure Drive link and the SHA256 of the zip before we download. Once we validate, we may open a follow-up request for additional telemetry under a data processing addendum.

If you can send the Drive link and sha256 by Wed EOD PST, we'll prioritize the review.

Elaine
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@cloudbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 02:37:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: IR artifacts and scoped logs for July 20 outage

Elaine — uploaded to the secure folder and attached the three deliverables you requested. Quick notes:

- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5E_Redwood-CloudBank-IR
- ZIP file: forensics_scope_log_samples_20260720.zip (contains manifest.txt, request_traces_20260720_windowA.ndjson, auth_events_20260720.log)
- SHA256: 3f8d9b2e6f4a7a5b2e6c9f1a8d7e3b4c2a9f1d6e8b4c3a7d1e5f2a6b9c4d1e2
- Playbook: redwood_IR_playbook_v1.3.pdf (redacted internal contact emails, removal of vendor-specific runbooks)
- SOC 2 mapping: soc2_mapping_matrix.xlsx (sheet1: mapping, sheet2: CAIQ crosswalk)

We removed kernel-level timestamps and generalized hostnames as requested. Manifest includes checksums and redaction notes. Let me know if you want a short walkthrough call Thu morning (targeting 09:00 PDT) to go over the artifacts.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_IR_playbook_v1.3.pdf (attachment stub), forensics_scope_log_samples_20260720.zip (attachment stub), soc2_mapping_matrix.xlsx (attachment stub)
